{{Quote|Warning: Tampering with the TA-350 Imperial probe unit is prohibited.|K0-29|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''K0-29''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] in the employ of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], K0-29 was tasked with guarding the [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] [[TA-350]] deep in [[the Tomb]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], though TA-350 was of the opinion that K0-29 was unintelligent&mdash;it reacted threateningly to any organic that approached TA-350, regardless of whether they appeared to be Imperial.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
K0-29 appears on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', accompanying TA-350.<ref name="TOR" />
